name: Buildkite

jit_provisioning.notes: Calendly states JIT provisioning is not supported; use SCIM instead

scim.notes: Add, update and remove users and group membership from the IdP; roles still managed in Calendly

sso.notes: Any SAML 2.0 IdP; available on Teams and Teams Plus with SSO add-on, and included on Enterprise
